caption: The video captures a nighttime scene in a grassy clearing where a campfire burns steadily. The fire is built as a pyramid of stacked logs, glowing with intense orange and yellow flames that flicker and shift shape continuously. Small bright sparks drift upward into the dark sky, while a faint column of smoke rises and tilts slightly. At the base, glowing embers among the logs remain largely static in position but pulse with varying brightness. To the right, a pile of grey rocks sits on the ground, and a line of dark pine trees stands against the deep blue night sky. The foreground consists of green grass with a worn dirt patch surrounding the fire. The camera remains fixed throughout the clip, showing the ongoing, dynamic process of the burning wood without any change in the surrounding environment.
